# Transit — Design Notes & Task Outline

## Overview

- **Source Template:** ColorLib Logistic (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/logistic/`)
- **New App Name:** `transit`
- **Design Category:** Logistics, Freight, and Transport Services

## Section-by-Section Fidelity Plan

1. **Top Bar & Navbar:**
   - Dark blue header background (`#1f2b6c`), orange accent (`#ff5e14`).
   - Contact phone/email on the left, social links on the right.
   - Sticky navigation bar with clean links and "Get a Quote" action button.
2. **Hero Section:**
   - Full-width hero banner with freight/transport background image styling.
   - Bold headline, professional subtitle, primary CTA button.
3. **Services Grid:**
   - 4-column or 3-column layout highlighting Air Freight, Ocean Freight, Road Transport, Warehousing.
   - Clean white cards with subtle shadow and orange accent icons.
4. **About & Stats Counter:**
   - Split layout: company overview / story + animated/static statistic cards (Clients, Shipments, Branches).
5. **Tracking & Quote Request Form:**
   - Interactive form allowing users to simulate tracking a shipment ID or requesting a freight quote.
6. **Testimonials & Blog / News:**
   - Carousel or grid of customer reviews.
   - Latest logistics insights articles.
7. **Footer:**
   - Deep navy background with multi-column links, contact details, newsletter signup.
   - Mandatory copyright footer with link to `https://www.componentdock.com/`.
